heading_en: Deemed Approval for Parent Companies of Financial Instruments Business Operators Already Using the Internal Management Model Approach Before the Application Date
summary_ja: 適用開始時点で内部管理モデル方式を用いている業者の親会社について、届出による第250条の承認のみなし規定と、その間の読替え的な基準適合のみなしを定める。
summary_en: Lets a parent company of a financial instruments business operator already using the internal management model approach file a document within one month of notification as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company, and treats it as approved under Article 250 with transitional deemed compliance with the quality and quantity standards.
paragraphs: A parent company that, at the start of application of this Public Notice, has as a Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. a financial instruments business operator that has obtained the approval under Article 11, paragraph (1) of the Stand-alone Capital Adequacy Notice and is using the internal management model approach, and that has been designated pursuant to Article 57-12, paragraph (1) of the Act by June 30, 2011 and has received notice under paragraph (3) of that Article that it is an Ultimate Designated Parent Company, may, only during the one month after the day on which it received that notice, submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency a document stating the matters listed in the items of Article 251, paragraph (1).

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has made the notification under the preceding paragraph is deemed to have obtained the approval under Article 250 on the day of that notification. In this case, until the end of December 2011, that Ultimate Designated Parent Company is deemed to satisfy the qualitative standards and quantitative standards of Article 252 by satisfying the standards listed in the items of Article 13, paragraph (1) of the Stand-alone Capital Adequacy Notice, and is deemed to satisfy the qualitative standards of Article 252, paragraph (2), the quantitative standards of paragraph (3) of that Article, and the standards listed in the items of Article 255, paragraph (1) by satisfying the standards listed in the items of Article 13, paragraph (4) of the Stand-alone Capital Adequacy Notice.
